interpretation: Upper bound for the specified base-weighted empirical VAL distribution; not an estimate of actual mutual information, physical entropy or semantic axes.
scope_notes: Dimension study is older dense/no-spatial DEVELOPMENT, not size convergence of the selected graph model.
All named selection payloads use validation_beta0.1.
Activity thresholds are descriptive; components within a fit are not independent fits.
Latent axes may change sign/permutation across fits.
Posterior collapse means input-independence, not a point distribution; broad variances near prior persist.
Optimization traces use one prespecified seed and fixed4000updates; they do not prove convergence.
